sql: SELECT coalesce(value::INTEGER::VARCHAR, 'NULL'), strftime(valid_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), level::VARCHAR, lead_time::VARCHAR, member::VARCHAR, strftime(run, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), (value IS NULL)::VARCHAR FROM read_om('/home/blizhan/repo/github/duckomo/test/data/dimensions_five_axes.om', dimensions := map(['value'], [['time','level','lead_time','member','run']]), axes := {'time': {'axis':'time','values':[TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 00:00:00',TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 01:00:00']},'level': {'axis':'level','kind':'pressure','unit':'hPa','values':[500.25,850.5]},'lead_time': {'axis':'lead_time','values':[INTERVAL '-1 hour',INTERVAL '0 second']},'member': {'axis':'member','values':[10::BIGINT,9223372036854775807::BIGINT]},'run': {'axis':'run','values':[TIMESTAMP '2026-09-29 00:00:00',TIMESTAMP '2026-09-29 12:00:00']}}) ORDER BY valid_time, level, lead_time, member, run
